headline: Keysight authors report an AI-generated power-amplifier behavioral model for system verification
fact: Keysight authors at DAC 2026 report a neural-network behavioral model of a power-amplifier circuit whose training data is generated through SystemVue and ADS co-simulation. The presented model covers transient behavior and a broad power range and can be imported into system-level simulation for performance verification and design; this records the reported method, not an independent validation of its accuracy or deployment scope.

sources.title: AI-Enabled High-Fidelity Power Amplifier Behavioral Modeling with Commercial EDA Tools
sources.summary: The official DAC 2026 record identifies the Keysight authors, July 27 date, co-simulation training flow, neural-network behavioral model, and system-level verification use.
